summary: All 81 requirements are implemented by 18 Java files (two controllers: gas analysis and movement). Below: 5 invented defaults, 2 ambiguities, 8 design choices and 1 scope question. Nothing is unimplemented.

issues.title: Constant values are not given by the requirements
issues.raw: CD-Const1..6 say the constants are configured at start-up but give no values. Chosen: THR = 2.0, LV = 1.0, EVADE_TIME = 1, STUCK_PERIOD = 3, STUCK_DIST = 1.0, OUT_PERIOD = 2 (times in clock ticks). All are integer-valued so that rounding fractional constants up in the model changes nothing; STUCK_PERIOD > EVADE_TIME so that both outcomes of stuck detection stay reachable.
issues.fix_directive: Replace the values in DetectorConstants if the system's real configuration is known; keep them integer-valued or note any guard whose meaning depends on a fraction.

issues.title: Initial values of state variables other than gs
issues.raw: Only gs has a specified initial value (empty, CD-GA-Var1). Chosen: sts = noGas, ins = 0.0, anl = Front, a = Front, l = front, d0 = d1 = 0.0, evasionStart = 0. Each is overwritten before it is read on every path, so the choice affects no behaviour.
issues.fix_directive: Change the field initialisers if particular initial values are required.

issues.title: Results of intensity and location on an empty reading
issues.raw: CD-Fn2 and CD-Fn3 have the precondition that the reading is non-empty and say nothing for an empty one. Chosen: intensity returns 0.0 and location returns Front.
issues.fix_directive: None needed unless an empty reading must be rejected instead.

issues.title: What makes a reading 'indicate the target chemical'
issues.raw: CD-Fn1 does not name the target chemical or say when a value indicates it. Chosen: the target Chem is passed to the GasSensorArray constructor; analysis returns gasD iff some value has c equal to the target and i > 0.0.
issues.fix_directive: Adjust GasSensorArray.analysis if presence should use a different criterion, such as a detection floor.

issues.title: Mapping from reading position to direction (angle)
issues.raw: CD-DM7 and CD-Fn3 say that a position (1-based) maps to a sensing direction but do not give the mapping. Chosen: positions 1, 2, 3, 4 map to Left, Right, Back, Front (declaration order of Angle), repeating for longer readings; a position below 1 maps to Front. When several positions share the peak intensity, location returns the first one.
issues.fix_directive: Change GasSensorArray.angle to the real sensor layout.

issues.title: Peak intensity and its location are taken over all chemicals
issues.raw: CD-Fn2 and CD-Fn3 define intensity and location over every value in the reading, while CD-Fn1 is about the target chemical only. If a reading also contains another chemical, the threshold check and the steering may be driven by that chemical. Implemented literally, over all values.
issues.fix_directive: If only target-chemical values should count, restrict the loops in intensity and location to values whose c is the target.

issues.title: Non-empty precondition of intensity and location is not stated in the code
issues.raw: GasDetected is entered only when analysis returned gasD, which in this Java needs a non-empty reading, so the preconditions of CD-Fn2 and CD-Fn3 always hold. The Java states no contract for this, so a model in which analysis is uninterpreted cannot see it.
issues.fix_directive: None in the Java, unless a verifier reports the precondition as unproved.

issues.title: Intensity is represented as real, and Chem as a record
issues.raw: CD-DM5 makes Intensity an abstract ordered type, but it must be compared with the numeric constant thr, so it is a double (real) throughout: GasSensor.i, ins, THR and goreq's parameters. Chem (CD-DM4) is a record with a nat id; only equality is used.

issues.title: The odometer is a sensor quantity sampled in actions, not an input event
issues.raw: CD-Evt3 says the movement subsystem samples the odometer into d0 or d1. Those samples happen inside actions whose trigger is already obstacle (or a guard), and a step can carry only one event, so the odometer is the zero-argument sensor method NavigationSensor.odometer().

issues.title: Vehicle-provided operations are actuator methods, not operation classes
issues.raw: CD-OP1..3 (move, randomWalk, shortRandomWalk) are typed 'operation', but CD-ARCH2 says the Vehicle provides them. They command the platform and compute no variables, and an operation class (argument-less compute() of field assignments) cannot carry move's arguments. They are methods of VehicleActuator, so there is no operation package.
issues.fix_directive: If operation classes are required for these, say what variables they should compute.

issues.title: changeDirection(l) is realised as move(lv, evasionAngle(l))
issues.raw: CD-OP4 needs the obstacle side l, which a parameterless compute() cannot take, and its effect is one move at lv. The left/right/front to Right/Left/Back mapping is the pure function NavigationSensor.evasionAngle, and Avoiding's entry calls vehicle.move(LV, sensor.evasionAngle(l)).

issues.title: Waiting's during action randomWalk() is issued on entry
issues.raw: The profile has no during actions. Because randomWalk is unbounded (it continues until superseded), it is issued on every transition into Waiting and once at start-up in the constructor (CD-MV-Beh1 has no action). The resume transitions' 'no action' (CD-MV-Beh3, 8, 12, 15, 20, 23) is respected in that the call is Waiting's own behaviour, written inline as the profile requires for target-state actions.

issues.title: Final states and unguarded transitions
issues.raw: GasDetected at or above thr goes to the terminal mode CONCLUDED (CD-GA-Beh6). Found goes on to a terminal mode HALTED by an unguarded transition, so that CD-MV-Beh9 has exactly one transition (CD-DC1). NoGas returns to Reading unguarded (CD-GA-Beh3). None of these is a self-loop, and every cycle through them contains an event.

issues.title: Timed waits and the evasion clock
issues.raw: wait(evadeTime) and wait(outPeriod) are Clock.delay calls. In Java the Clock is logical time advanced by advance() and by delay(). The evasion clock T is the field evasionStart, restarted on both transitions into Avoiding (CD-MV-Beh7, Beh17); stuck detection compares timer.now() - evasionStart with STUCK_PERIOD.

issues.title: Order of Analysis's two guarded branches
issues.raw: The requirements list noGas (CD-GA-Beh4) before gasD (CD-GA-Beh5). The code tests readingHasTarget first and then !readingHasTarget, so the second guard is the negation of the first. The guards are complementary, so the order does not change behaviour.

issues.title: Routing of turn, stop and resume between the subsystems
issues.raw: Gas analysis emits OutputEvent.Turn, Stop and Resume through a SignalActuator; movement consumes InputEvent.Turn, Stop and Resume. The records share names so that they form the shared events of CD-ARCH2. No wiring class was written: forwarding emitted events into MovementController.step is left to the integrator, as is calling step(null) when no event occurred.
issues.fix_directive: Add a system class that forwards events if a runnable composition is in scope.

next_step: Run the pipeline (compile, coverage, profile check, transformations, FDR4, Dafny, Isabelle, vacuity).
